raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The DE-412 change added `ingest_ts - txn_ts <= 26 hours` to silver_transactions, which silently drops valid late-arriving POSTED transactions. The source routinely delivers transactions about 2–3 days after txn_ts (e.g., txn 2026-01-13 06:01 ingested 2026-01-16 02:00), and txn_ids are unique, so these are not duplicates. Removing the latency filter, while keeping the POSTED filter, restores the dropped rows.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.72, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
